main_measure.name: pooled excess forward 5-bar return after forecast <= -10 (vs coin-window mean)
main_measure.threshold: confirm: excess < 0 with t <= -2 and negative in at least 2 of 3 coins; reject: excess > 0 with t >= +2; minimum 30 non-overlapping extreme cases

supporting_check.name: number of coins with negative mean excess return (need >= 2)

decided_by: t lies strictly between -2 and +2 (inconclusive rule).
reading: Extreme cases are grid bars (positions 0,5,10,... per window) with forecast <= -10 and a defined in-window 5-bar forward return, the baseline is the mean forward 5-bar return over all bars of that coin-window that have one, and with BNB absent the 'at least 2 of the 3 coins' rule is applied literally as at least 2 negative coins among those present.
